## Highest‑Weight Open Items (⚡)

| # | Item | Conf | Deadline | Status |
|---|------|------|----------|--------|
| 1 | Integrate a MemGPT‑style virtual‑context paging layer into the append‑only baseline to keep active context succinct and avoid recall interference. | 0.68 | **After next GPU run** (within the 2400 H100 hrs) | Drafted: *“Implement paging module; benchmark against rewrite baseline (beyond 40 items).”* |
| 2 | Add a compression‑based consolidation step to the naive‑append memory architecture to block the 40‑item QA accuracy drop. | 0.68 | **Before end of next data‑shuffle** | Drafted: *“Wrap each append with a summarizer (e.g., GPT‑3.5‑compact) and evaluate QA on 50‑item streams.”* |
| 3 | Expand the agents’ episodic‑memory survey into the workshop benchmark, including MemGPT paging in the task set. | 0.66 | **Week 3** | Pending: *“Define survey‑derived tasks and integrate into benchmark suite.”* |
| 4 | Run a rewrite‑vs‑append ablation sweep, incorporating the periodic consolidation technique from the recent compression paper. | 0.65 | **Week 4** | Drafted: *“Allocate 500 GPU‑hrs to 3 seed runs; capture F1 gap and interference metrics.”* |
| 5 | (Optional) Test a hybrid MemGPT‑paging + periodic‑consolidation memory system to achieve rewrite‑level performance with lower token‑budget usage. | 0.65 | **Week 5** | Drafted: *“Prototype hybrid stack; benchmark against pure rewrite.”* |

> **Nudges**  
> • **Workshop outline review** – Maya wants a quick pass to ensure the benchmark sections align with the reviewer’s ablation request.  
> • **Camera‑ready for submission 4127** is due in **two weeks**. Hook this up to the results from the rewrite‑vs‑append sweep.  
> • **GPU budget** – track usage; aim to keep < 70 % of the 2400 GPU‑hrs in the first 4 weeks to reserve slack for follow‑ups.

## Pending Actions

- **Draft:** Reply to Maya: *“Thanks, the outline looks solid. I’ll give it another read tonight and flag any missing benchmark details tomorrow.”*  
- **Draft:** Email editor of Journal X: *“We’ll submit the camera‑ready <two‑week cut‑off>. Please confirm the final page limit.”*  

## Overnight Idea

> **Overnight idea:**  
> Leverage the confirmed insight that a **MemGPT‑style virtual‑context paging baseline** will satisfy the ICLR reviewer’s ablation demand. Configure the baseline to mirror the rewrite experiment’s dataset, then present the benchmark results in the workshop paper. This will both inject a realistic control and showcase the rewrite method’s gains more convincingly.
